source: the development box's TP=1 state file (RUST_GLM_STATE_DB) after a day of serving, 2026-11-12/13: seed v0 (150K tokens of corpus/sources prefilled), then everything the engine routed - the author's chat traffic (Open WebUI, Pi harness), bench/bench.py runs (prose, code, random 8K), and 438K prompt tokens of long-prompt tests over this repository's text (23K-305K-token prompts, about 15% of the rows). routed_rows is the mass / 2.5 (the router's scale: one routed row adds 2.5): every prompt token and every decode verify row, rejected drafts included. tokens is the engine's counter since its last boot (it restarts at 0 each boot), not the history's size.
contents: Aggregate router mass per (layer, expert) and a token count only; no prompts, responses, KV, or model weights.
